Subject: Minimum monthly floor for POC

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the latency numbers look promising. We are a small team running a pilot for dynamic parking recommendations and want to move quickly, but our finance team is nervous about large monthly commitments.

Can you share what minimum monthly spend or "starter" commit options look like for hosted API (no Dedicated)? Ideally something that lets us have predictable unit pricing and a small commitment while we validate revenue. Also curious about onboarding credits or activation credits for the first 90 days.

Primary questions:
- What are recommended minimum floors for SMB pilots (volume ~2M tokens/mo)?
- Any limited-time onboarding credits or PO activation credits?
- Can we agree a simple overage rate if we exceed the floor?

Happy to include our procurement alias if you need an official quote.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Product
QuickPark

Elena — great to connect yesterday. Appreciate the clarity on scale.

Short answers up front:
- For SMB pilots at ~2M tokens/month we typically propose a 1–3 month starter floor in the $1k–$5k/month range depending on token mix (generation vs embeddings).
- We can offer a one-time activation credit (applied to the first invoice) and a 60–90 day trial-style credit to reduce initial spend risk.
- Overage is billed at a transparent per-token rate; we can tier the overage so it softens as you scale.

I've looped in Rachel (account lead) and Jonas (pricing) to provide a concrete small-account offer and the short PDF with two starter options. If procurement wants a formal PO template, attach the doc and we can return a Quote/Invoice link.

Next step: Jonas, can you propose two clean, small-account floors (conservative and growth) with credits and overage band? Rachel, I'll leave cadence and billing terms to you to follow up with procurement.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, US
Redwood Inference

Hi all — putting concrete numbers on the table. Attached is a two-option starter offer and a short explanation of overage mechanics. Summary below.

Option A — Conservative starter (recommended if budget-constrained):
- Floor: $1,200/month (applies to first 3 months)
- Included: up to 2M tokens/month (mixed generation/embedding profile)
- Overage: $0.0009 per token (first 1M over floor), drops to $0.0007/token thereafter
- Activation credit: $600 applied to first invoice (effectively 50% off month 1)
- Contract: simple 3-month rolling; cancel with 30-day notice after month 3

Option B — Growth starter (recommended if testing higher concurrency):
- Floor: $3,500/month (applies to first 3 months)
- Included: up to 6M tokens/month, priority onboarding queue for instance tuning
- Overage: $0.00075 per token (first 2M over floor), then $0.0006/token
- Activation credit: $1,000 applied to first invoice
- Add-on: one free model-ops consultation (2 hours) during onboarding

Other notes:
- We can provide a monthly usage dashboard and per-route cost breakdown so you can reallocate volume to embeddings vs generation (different token economics).
- Standard payment terms are Net 30; we can accept a PO and issue an invoice.
- If procurement needs a formal Quote PDF signed, we can generate it once QuickPark confirms Option A or B.

I've attached: Redwood_Small-Account-Offer.pdf and QuickPark_PO_Template.docx (PO template for procurement).

Markus/Rachel: feel free to tweak the activation credit if we want a higher first-month discount to accelerate sign-off.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
